caption:
Global Metadata: A stirring Scottish bagpipe piece, 96 BPM, proud and martial. Led by the great highland bagpipe (chanter melody over a continuous drone) with its bright, reedy, sustained tone, joined by a steady side drum (snare) and a deep bass drum. The bagpipe plays a proud, soaring, march-like melody over the constant drone, the drums add a firm martial rhythm, building to a triumphant peak and a strong final chord. Production profile: close, vivid marching-band recording, bright reedy bagpipe, crisp drums, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, the bagpipe drone alone establishes a proud mood. Section one, the bagpipe chanter enters with a soaring march-like melody over the drone. Section two, the side drum and bass drum join with a firm martial rhythm. Section three, the music builds to a triumphant peak. Outro, a strong final chord and a decisive ending.
